name: Manycore Tech Inc.
summary: Manycore Tech Inc. provides software-as-a-service platform that offers users with computer-aided design and modeling capabilities for residential, commercial, and industrial spaces in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It offers Kujiale, a cloud-native design software that enables users to carry out 3D design, visualization, and implementation; Coohom, an international version of Kujiale; and Modelo, a 3D-centric digital assets management and collaboration software to reshape the communication standard and digital data flow within the architecture, engineering, and construction industry.
